purpose: Preview mockups only; no site implementation or original asset changes.

options.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity desktop webpage section mockup by editing input image 1.
Input image 1 is the exact section screenshot and STRICT composition/edit target. Input image 2 is the full-resolution original Earn credits illustration, to preserve all its details. Input image 3 is the full-resolution original Bring your own testers illustration, to preserve all its details.
Preserve image 1's full framing, aspect ratio, content, proportions, spacing, typography, positions and sizes exactly. Centered section heading; first row has Earn illustration LEFT and copy/button RIGHT; second row has copy/button LEFT and Share illustration RIGHT. Do not rearrange into cards or side-by-side methods. Keep both original illustrations' exact overlapping white UI panels, icons, avatars, glyphs, labels, gray lines, shadows and placement, but recolor ONLY their outer backdrop as specified below. No redrawing, removing or adding illustration details. Flat screenshot, no device frame or perspective.
ALL text must stay verbatim, with no extra content:
Section heading "2 paid free ways to get feedback" with ONLY "paid" struck through, "free" blue, all else dark.
First copy "Earn 1:1 credits"; "Earn credits 1:1 (we don't take a cut)"; button "Earn credits".
Second copy "Bring your own testers"; "There are no limits - bring as many as you want"; button "Get started".
Illustration 1 text: "Test completed", "You earned", "1 credit", "Your test".
Illustration 2 text: "Responses", "Great onboarding flow!", "The value prop is clear.", "Share test link", "test4test.io/t/your-test", "Copy link".
Keep existing blue buttons and dark gray text and all typography exactly. No labels such as Option, no badges, no captions, no new numbers, no extra copy, no gradient, no decorative shapes. Existing illustrations are the only artwork. Output one complete section image at source aspect ratio (1425:1190) with sharp readable type, no cropping.
COLOR EDIT FOR THIS OPTION: Keep the entire surrounding section canvas pure white #FFFFFF, exactly as the source. Keep the Earn illustration background very pale blue #E1F6FF and change only the navy outer backdrop of the Share illustration to the exact same very pale blue #E1F6FF. Retain both existing rounded rectangular illustration bounds. This is the smallest intervention: two equally light illustrations on white. Preserve all white UI panels and everything else.
